name: loupe
description: Keeps agent-written wp-admin interfaces on the WordPress Design System. An authoring skill that sets the rules before the first draft, a conformance engine that correlates JSX component bindings with the CSS styling them — across stylesheets, inline styles and CSS-in-JS — names the exact token that replaces a hardcoded value, and catches composites rebuilt across files, plus hooks that report drift at write time rather than at review time.

blocking.title: Block turns on findings
blocking.description: When on, error-severity findings stop the turn and hand the report back. When off, the gate reports only. A project with no loupe.config.json is always advisory unless this is on.

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: auto, or any bundled preset (`loupe presets` lists them — wpds, wordpress-components, wordpress-block-theme, generic). 'auto' infers the preset from the markers each preset declares. A project's own loupe.config.json always wins.

project_prefixes.title: Project class prefixes
project_prefixes.description: Comma-separated CSS class prefixes your projects own, e.g. 'vip-workflow-, wf-'. Leave empty to infer per project. Only these can be reported dead.

max_attempts.title: Fix attempts before standing down
max_attempts.description: Re-checks per session before the gate lets the turn through.

max_findings.title: Findings shown per report
max_findings.description: Cap per report, sampled across rules.
